summary.text: Natha Anderson is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 30 since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her as a teacher by profession.

paragraphs.text: Natha Anderson was born in Reno, Nevada, and earned a B.A. in education from the University of Nevada, Reno; her career experience includes working as a teacher.
She assumed office on November 4, 2020, after winning the 2020 general election for District 30, succeeding Greg Smith.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Natural Resources (as chair) and Ways and Means committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Trista Gomez.
